verdict.rationale: Modal documents a public programmatic API for Sandboxes through its SDKs. The Python Sandbox reference covers creation parameters, exec, logs and snapshots, and the JS/Go SDK guide shows creating a Sandbox and running commands; the official CLI and community gRPC usage add corroboration. However, the API is exposed only through client SDKs, with no published REST/OpenAPI specification (all OpenAPI probes returned 404), and snapshots are still marked experimental. missing for 10: a documented language-agnostic HTTP/REST API with an OpenAPI spec, stable (non-experimental) coverage of all sandbox features, independent hands-on corroboration of the SDK API surface

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
